$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editors; ignored by Janus.

host.description: Address to bind. A non-loopback address is reported as a warning: Janus has no authentication.

port.description: Port to bind; 0 picks a free port.

strictTrailingSlash.description: true: "/a/" never matches "/a". false: exactly one trailing "/" is dropped before matching.

autoOptions.description: true: an OPTIONS request to a fixture path without an OPTIONS directory gets 204 with Allow. false: it gets 405.

root.description: Fixture root directory, relative to this file's directory.

watch.description: true: watch the fixture root and reload the snapshot when files change. An invalid edit never replaces the served snapshot.

onUnknownMethod.description: When the path exists but the method does not: 405 with Allow, or 404 route-not-found without disclosing methods.

onNoFixture.description: When no route matches in the selected scenario: 404 route-not-found, or 501 not-mocked, which cannot be mistaken for an application 404.

maxUrlBytes.description: Longest request target, in bytes; longer is 414 url-too-long.

maxHeaderBytes.description: Largest total request header size, in bytes; larger is 431 headers-too-large.

maxBodyBytes.description: Largest request body, in bytes; larger is 413 request-too-large.

maxDecodedBodyBytes.description: Largest request body after removing its Content-Encoding, in bytes; larger is 413 decoded-body-too-large. At least limits.maxBodyBytes.

mediaTypePreference.description: Media types to prefer, first first, when Accept ranks several representations equally. Unlisted types follow in lexical order.

onUnusableAccept.description: An Accept header with no usable media range: 400 invalid-request, or any to treat it as */*.

onUnacceptable.description: No representation matches Accept: 406 not-acceptable, or ignore to serve the first by mediaTypePreference, then lexical order.

headers.description: false removes every X-Mock-* diagnostic header Janus adds. The trace is unaffected.

now.description: The instant dynamic values render against, as RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-01-01T00:00:00Z); null uses the wall clock.

clockMode.description: frozen: dynamic.now never moves. offset: it starts at dynamic.now and advances with the wall clock.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for dates such as {{$today}}; never the host zone.

seed.description: Seed for generated values; null picks one at startup and reports it at /_janus/clock.

strictRefs.description: true: a request value a token needs but the request lacks is 500 render-failed instead of null or "".

aliases.description: Custom clock aliases, name: <base><offsets>, e.g. trialEnd: today+30d.

resolve.description: false disables POST /_janus/resolve, the resolution explorer: it then answers 404.

enabled.description: false stops serving the Atlas UI at /_janus/ui/; --no-ui does the same.

origins.description: Origins whose pages may call the Atlas API across origins, such as http://localhost:5173; ["*"] allows any. Empty disables CORS.

maxAge.description: How long browsers may cache a preflight, in seconds.

origins.description: Origins whose pages may call the fixture routes across origins; ["*"] allows any. Empty disables fixture CORS. Never applies to the Atlas.

credentials.description: true lets pages send cookies to the fixture routes and read the answers. Not with ["*"].

maxAge.description: How long browsers may cache a fixture preflight, in seconds.

default.description: The scenario a request gets without X-Mock-Scenario or a session pin; it must be a scenario directory. --scenario does the same.

keyFrom.description: Where a session key comes from when X-Mock-Session is absent: header.<name> or cookie.<name> entries, the first present one hashed into the session ID.

idleTimeout.description: Seconds after its last request that a session expires.

max.description: Sessions that may exist at once; creating one more is 503 session-limit.

enabled.description: false resolves every retried request again instead of replaying the response a session got for its Idempotency-Key.

header.description: The request header carrying the idempotency key. Not X-Mock-*, a hop-by-hop header or Content-Type.

methods.description: The methods whose retries are replayed.

maxEntries.description: Stored responses one session may hold; storing one more drops that session's oldest.

endpoints.description: The requests X-Mock-Record: true may forward: each a method, a path template such as /v1/products/{productId}, and the http or https upstream it is sent to. Empty disables recording.

captures.description: Where recorded exchanges are written, relative to this file's directory. Never inside fixtures.root; never served.

allowNonLoopback.description: true allows recording on a non-loopback listener: any client that can reach the port can then call every registered upstream.

maxConcurrent.description: Recordings that may be in progress at once; one more is 503 recording-busy.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds an upstream has to send its whole response; longer is 504 recording-upstream-timeout.

maxResponseBytes.description: Largest upstream response body, in bytes; larger is 502 recording-response-too-large.

mode.description: staged keeps captures until someone promotes one; auto promotes each successful capture into its scenario as soon as it is written, pending review.

enabled.description: false turns off every fault and every delay at once; fault.yaml and latency are still loaded and described.

timeoutMs.description: How long a timeout fault holds a connection before Janus closes it, in milliseconds.

maxHeldConnections.description: Connections timeout faults may hold at once; one more gets 503 fault-capacity-exceeded.

latency.description: The server-wide delay before the first byte: { ms: N } or { min: A, max: B } in milliseconds, or null for none.

enabled.description: false sends every fixture body uncompressed, whatever Accept-Encoding asks for.

encodings.description: The codings Janus may use, preferred first when Accept-Encoding ranks them equally.

minBytes.description: Smallest JSON or text body Janus compresses, in bytes.

xml.description: true: body.<JSONPath> references read XML request bodies as a document. false: an XML body is a missing value.

root.description: Where saved requests, collections and environments live, relative to this file's directory. Never inside fixtures.root or recording.captures.

allowNonLoopback.description: true makes the request runner available on a non-loopback listener: any client that can reach the port can then make Janus send requests anywhere it can reach.

maxActiveRuns.description: Runs that may be in progress at once; one more is 503 runner-busy.

keepRuns.description: Finished runs kept in memory for the Atlas and the UI.

scriptTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds one pre-request or post-response script may run; longer fails the step script-timeout.

scriptMemoryBytes.description: Largest heap one script may use, in bytes; more fails the step script-memory.

maxImportBytes.description: Largest import, in bytes, across all its files; a zip may expand to four times this.

extraCaCerts.description: PEM files of certificate authorities (or self-signed certificates) trusted for runner and recording requests besides the platform's, relative to this file's directory.

skipTlsVerify.description: Accept any certificate from the upstream for runner and recording requests, unverified. Only for dev, test or staging backends.

title: Janus configuration
description: Settings for the Janus mock server (janus.config.yaml).
